findings.summary: cli.ts fold validity guard (decide Q7) had no covering test; reverting it to 'const prev = raw' stayed green. Fixed in 1a4d9664b358b369010dc6039970ce927e21585e: a CLI e2e seeding staleHandoff 999 at turn 2, observed RED under that revert.

Nit: the '1c touches only B3' decision-nudge row uses staleCommits [] so 1c is never evaluated; its name claimed more than it checks. Renamed and its comment states what it pins (the two rules cannot both apply).

Informational: 1c is inert (B3 fires) when the brain path and cwd disagree through a symlink (macOS /var vs /private/var) or the brain is not at HEAD, because the shared line count reads every line as new. Errs toward firing (decide Q5's disclosed limit); disclosed in the test helper comment. No change.
